in_sanskrit.name: Logesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Logesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Logesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'loga' meaning 'people' and 'ish' meaning 'God'. The name signifies the grace of God upon the people. In Hindu mythology, Logesh is the name of a deity who is believed to bestow divine blessings and protect his devotees.
